about.title: Cooking with time-honoured recipes
about.p1: La Cocinita was born in a small space in Madrid de los Austrias with a simple idea: to cook the way our grandmothers did. Chickpeas are soaked the night before, the sofrito is never rushed and our stews are made in clay pots.
about.p2: We shop at the market every morning and work with producers from Madrid and the surrounding area. The menu changes with the seasons, but some dishes never change: Wednesday's cocido, the ham croquettes and our house torrija.
about.p3: We are a neighbourhood eating house: checked tablecloths, tiled walls and friendly service. Come hungry and leave your watch at home.
about.imgAlt: Clay pot on the stove in La Cocinita's kitchen

service.title: How our table service works
service.lead: At La Cocinita you can use your phone to reach our dining room team without raising your hand. It's very easy, free, and there's nothing to install.
service.onlyInside: The app only works inside the restaurant, connected to our Wi-Fi. There are no links or downloads on this website.
service.step1d: You'll find the network name and password on the card on your table. If you can't see it, just ask your waiter.
service.step2d: Open your phone's camera and point it at the QR code. Each table has its own, so we know where you are.
service.step3d: It opens straight in your phone's browser. No downloads and no accounts needed.
service.step4d: Call the waiter, browse the menu, send messages or requests by typing or by voice, and ask for the bill whenever you like.
service.step5d: Your request reaches the dining room team immediately, and they will come to your table as soon as they can.
service.f3: Send messages or requests, by typing or by voice
service.q1: Do I need to download anything?
service.a1: No. The app opens in your phone's browser when you scan the QR code. There's nothing to install and no need to sign up.
service.q2: Do I have to use it?
service.a2: Not at all. It's just an extra convenience. You can call the waiter as usual and you'll be looked after just as well.
service.a3: Yes. We don't ask for your name, phone number or any personal details. Requests are only used to serve your table during your visit, and the app runs on the restaurant's own network.
service.q4: What if I don't have a phone, or it doesn't work?
service.a4: No problem: traditional service is always available. Our dining room team will look after your table just like any other.
service.q5: Can I order my food from the app?
service.a5: You can browse the menu and send requests, and the waiter will come to your table to take your order and offer advice.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.html:
This English version is provided for information only. In case of discrepancy, the Spanish version prevails.

1. Data controller

  • Controller: {{legal.titular}}
  • Tax ID (NIF/CIF): {{legal.nif}}
  • Address: {{legal.domicilio}}
  • Email: {{legal.email}}

2. What data we process

This website has no forms and does not collect personal data by itself. We only process your data if you contact us:

  • By phone: your name, phone number and booking details (date, time, number of people, and any notes such as allergies if you tell us about them).
  • By WhatsApp: also your number and the content of your messages. WhatsApp is a service of WhatsApp Ireland Ltd. (Meta) with its own privacy policy.
  • By email: your email address and the content of your message.

3. Purpose

To manage your booking or answer your enquiry. We do not create profiles or send advertising.

4. Legal basis

Taking steps at your request before entering into a contract (managing the booking) and your consent when you contact us, under Article 6(1)(b) and 6(1)(a) of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR). Allergy information is only processed with your explicit consent, so that we can serve you safely.

5. Retention

Booking data is kept for as long as needed to manage the booking and for no more than [EDITAR] 30 days after the booking date, unless the law requires otherwise.

6. Recipients

We do not share your data with third parties unless required by law. Some technology providers (telephone, WhatsApp, email, and GitHub Pages web hosting) may access it as data processors or as part of their own services.

7. QR table service

The table service app used inside the restaurant does not ask for personal data: requests are only linked to the table number and are used to serve you during your visit.

8. Your rights

You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing and data portability by writing to {{legal.email}}. If you believe we have not handled your data properly, you can complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).

9. Browsing data

The website's server (GitHub Pages) may log technical data such as your IP address to keep the service secure. Please also see our Cookie policy.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.html:
This English version is provided for information only. In case of discrepancy, the Spanish version prevails.

1. What are cookies?

Cookies and similar technologies (such as the browser's local storage) are small files that a website stores on your device to remember information about your visit.

2. What we use on this website

This website does not use analytics or advertising cookies.

NameTypePurposeDuration
lc_langTechnical (local storage, first-party)Remembers the language you choseUntil you delete it
lc_cookiesTechnical (local storage, first-party)Remembers your cookie choice12 months
Google cookiesThird-party (optional)Show the interactive Google Maps map. They only load if you accept them.Set by Google

The PDF menu is displayed with the PDF.js library, which is downloaded from the cdnjs service (Cloudflare). This service does not set cookies, although it technically receives your IP address in order to deliver the file.

3. How to accept, reject or change your choice

On your first visit you will see a notice with Accept, Reject and Settings buttons. You can change your choice at any time using the “Cookie settings” link in the footer.

You can also delete or block cookies in your browser settings (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge…). If you block technical storage, the website will still work, but it will not remember your language.

4. Third-party cookies

Google Maps is a service of Google LLC. You can find out how Google uses cookies at policies.google.com/technologies/cookies.

5. Changes

We may update this policy if the services on the website change. The date of the last update is shown at the end of this page.
